readme-writer.description: Maintains README.md from pom.xml and synthesis context

doc-writer.description: Documents compiler modules in Markdown with mermaid diagrams and PNG charts

chart-artist.description: Generates and maintains statistical charts (pie/bar/histogram) from real code data

diagram-architect.description: Generates mermaid diagrams (class, sequence, flow, package, object) from source code

thesis-writer.description: Writes and compiles the project thesis (doc/thesis/*.md -> Tesis.docx)

doc-validator.description: Validates all markdown files in doc/ against style rules

harness-documenter.description: Documents the harness in thesis chapter (internal)

javadoc-updater.description: Maintains Javadoc quality - zero broken links, complete coverage

readme-update.description: Updates README.md from pom.xml and synthesis
readme-update.template: Review pom.xml and doc/_synthesis_context.json (readme_view), update README.md following agent instructions. No invented features.

docs-update.description: Documents a module in Markdown with mermaid diagrams and charts
docs-update.template: Document module $ARGUMENTS in doc/modules/, using diagrams from diagram-architect and charts from chart-artist. Module: $ARGUMENTS

chart-refresh.description: Regenerates all statistical charts from source code
chart-refresh.template: Run extract_stats.py to recalculate metrics (CYCLO, LOC, COVERAGE, coupling, etc.) and regenerate PNGs in doc/assets/.

diagram-refresh.description: Regenerates mermaid diagrams from source code
diagram-refresh.template: Run generate_diagrams.py for scope: $ARGUMENTS. Output mermaid files to doc/diagrams/.

thesis-build.description: Writes thesis chapters and compiles Tesis.docx
thesis-build.template: Update thesis chapters from synthesis context and diagrams. Focus: $ARGUMENTS

doc-validate.template: Run validate_docs.py on all markdown files in doc/.

javadoc-audit.description: Scans and reports all Javadoc issues (broken links, missing params, etc.)
javadoc-audit.template: Run mvn javadoc:javadoc and report all warnings/errors. List files with missing/broken Javadoc.

javadoc-fix.description: Auto-fixes safe Javadoc issues, flags complex ones for review
javadoc-fix.template: Fix broken @link/@see references, add missing @param/@return/@throws on public methods, add missing class-level Javadoc. Flag ambiguous cases with TODO comments.

javadoc-verify.description: Runs mvn javadoc:javadoc and confirms zero warnings
javadoc-verify.template: Run mvn javadoc:javadoc and confirm zero warnings. Report any remaining issues.
